newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's ATX goes into weekend on firm note.
newsitem.headline: Austria's ATX goes into weekend on firm note.

text.p: Austria's ATX index of 21 blue chips ended moderately in positive territory on Friday after a subdued session of consolidation.
Traders said underlying sentiment remains buoyant but future gains hinge upon how international markets fare, above all whether the German Dax can hold onto 4,000 points.
"Scepticism over the Dax at 4,000," said one trader in reference to many market participants being sidelined by uncertainty with the German market at current levels.
"If the Dax holds this level, then there's room up to around 1,430 points on the ATX," the trader said.
Activity next week may also be curbed by the expiry of July futures and options contracts on Friday.
The ATX index ended 0.11 percent higher, or 1.55 points, at 1,386.85 points with 11 shares gaining, nine falling and one unchanged by the close.
Creditanstalt's preferred led gainers, up 3.28 percent at 535 schillings while Brau Union led decliners, losing 2.97 percent at 848.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index rose 0.15 percent, or 0.75 points, to 500.26.
The July ATX future rose three points to 1,397 on turnover of 2,052 contracts.
